In the service blueprint, the **Discovery** `scenario` sits in the `Application` `phase` on the `Standard` `path` (the live happy path). 

I read the scenario's rows in the blueprint just now, so this is current.

---

### What Discovery Covers

The **Discovery** `scenario` maps the recruitment and initial intake funnel for prospective tutors, moving through three primary `step` moments:

1. **Discovers PLUS** — Prospective candidates encounter PLUS through five parallel entry channels:
   - **Word of mouth:** Referred by previous or current tutors ([`Application › Discovery › Standard — Regular Tutor × Discovers PLUS`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070103) / [`Front Stage Actions`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070104)).
   - **Social media:** Channels managed by the marketing team ([`Application › Discovery › Standard — Regular Tutor × Discovers PLUS`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070203) / [`Back Stage Actions`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070207)).
   - **Marketing website:** Content maintained by design and dev ([`Application › Discovery › Standard — Regular Tutor × Discovers PLUS`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070303) / [`Back Stage Actions`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070307)).
   - **On-campus activities:** Campus job fair booths and printed posters ([`Application › Discovery › Standard — Regular Tutor × Discovers PLUS`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070403) / [`Front Stage Touchpoints`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070406)).
   - **Handshake:** Postings managed by the tutor supervisor team ([`Application › Discovery › Standard — Regular Tutor × Discovers PLUS`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070503) / [`Back Stage Actions`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070507)).

2. **Interested in joining PLUS** — Candidates submit an initial interest form via Handshake or the website ([`Application › Discovery › Standard — Regular Tutor × Interested in joining PLUS`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070603)). Submitting this form is not yet an application—it registers interest and funnels candidates to the next mandatory gate.

3. **Attends info session** — Candidates attend a required PLUS info session hosted by the tutor supervisor team ([`Application › Discovery › Standard — Regular Tutor × Attends info session`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000611) / [`Front Stage Actions`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000613)). Attendance is tracked backstage ([`Application › Discovery › Standard — Back Stage Actions × Attends info session`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000614)); only attendees receive the post-info-session application form, which acts as the real screening gate and first interview.

---

### Which Lane Does Most of the Work?

- **Candidate side (`customer_actions`):** The **`Regular Tutor`** `lane` has the highest cell count and action volume (7 `cell` rows). It anchors the entire scenario, covering each of the 5 discovery touchpoints, form submission, and info session attendance.
- **Operational / Staff side:** Behind the candidate, the **tutor supervisor team** carries the operational weight across:
  - **`Front Stage Actions`** (3 `cell` rows): Staffing job fair booths and running the required info sessions.
  - **`Back Stage Actions`** (4 `cell` rows): Managing Handshake job postings, maintaining info-session slides, and tracking attendance to gate who receives an application form.
